ai_summary: Amber Enterprises India Limited is notifying shareholders about the mandatory transfer of unclaimed dividends and associated shares to the Investor Education and Protection Fund (IEPF), in compliance with the Companies Act, 2013, for dividends unpaid for seven years. Affected shareholders, exemplified by an unclaimed FY 2019-20 interim dividend, have an urgent deadline of December 8, 2026, to claim their assets directly from the company to avoid this transfer. Inaction will result in their shares and dividends being moved to the government fund, requiring a more involved process for reclamation through the IEPF Authority, underscoring the urgency for shareholders to respond.
